note: Official names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are written for this entry, in our own words, and each cites its sources.

cryptogames.name: CryptoGames — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements Full List

egamers.name: eGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — it is the reward for finishing everything else. Follow the roadmap in order: story first, then the stranger strands, then collectibles and activities, and save the 100% completion cleanup for last. Expect roughly 200 hours in total.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed — play through the opening until the mission-complete screen appears.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 by playing its missions through to the chapter's end. Do this one thing first, before the chapter closes: meditate on Lucia's balcony. That meditation spot is only available in Chapter 1, and missing it costs you the only missable trophy in the game.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. It is story-only: play the chapter's missions in order and the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Like the other chapter trophies it comes from the story alone — finish every mission the chapter gives you and it pops at the end.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Finish its missions in order; the trophy pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. Before you start it, make a manual save: there is no mission replay, so that save is your only way back if you still have cleanup to do afterwards. Finish the mission and the gold trophy pops.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as the story reaches it — play the main missions in order and it will come to you.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a heist mission in the main story path; finish it and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Play the main story in order; the mission arrives on its own and the trophy pops when it is done.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It is part of the main story path — finish the mission and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Finish the mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It comes late in the story; play the main missions in order until it unlocks, then finish it.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the hardest trophy in the game. Completion counts the story, the stranger strands, the collectibles, the activities and exploring the whole state together, so work through the roadmap and use this tracker's checklist to see what is left. It should be the last trophy you earn, after everything else is done.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Jumps, near-misses, airtime and drifts all count toward the total, and the counter keeps climbing across the whole game. String stunts together while driving between missions instead of grinding them in one sitting.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: the shooting range, a race, fishing, an arcade game, bowling and the rest. One try of each is enough — you do not need to win any of them, just take part.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's weapon and target pattern, then chase gold one challenge at a time; the range keeps your best medal per challenge, so a silver on a hard one is just a reason to go back.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location has its own race, and a win at each is what counts — not a time, just first place at all fourteen.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Variety is what counts: winning the same race twice still counts once, so work through the race list across the state and tick off a new one each time.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and out-fish him in the challenge itself. A steady retrieve and watching the line tension beats rushing it — let him tire himself out and reel in when the line allows.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Walk up to any arcade cabinet, play a game through to its end, and the trophy pops when it finishes — you do not need a high score.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is one of the stranger mission lines: meet him, follow his missions through, and the trophy pops at the strand's finale.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand is one of the stranger mission lines — work through his missions in order until the last one is done.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is one of the stranger mission lines — follow it to its final mission and finish it.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more than eight strands in the state, so you can pick the ones you enjoy — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have one. Each strand's missions unlock as you meet its stranger.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is one of the stranger mission lines — follow his missions through to the finale.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is one of the stranger mission lines — work through his missions until the last one is done.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 meditation spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY: Lucia's balcony meditation spot is only available in Chapter 1 and disappears after that chapter, so meditate there before Chapter 1 ends. The other 17 spots stay available for the rest of the game. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter so a missed spot is never the end of a playthrough.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at a one-of-a-kind animal — track it down, take the shot cleanly, and the trophy pops when the hunt is done.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, houses and out in the wild — and a set only counts when it is full. Collect three complete sets and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK It photo spots are spread across the whole state; snap the photo at each of 100 different spots. Sweep area by area so you do not revisit the same places twice.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small objectives layered over the open world, and any fifty count — so pick the easiest ones first and let the rest fill in as you play.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get the police up to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies in a row with your partner beside you, and keep the wanted level from dropping between them — plan a route of three close shops and move fast between them.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Just drive or ride anything new — each new vehicle you get into adds to the count. Variety across the state fills it naturally; try a new car, bike, boat or plane whenever you see one.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a busy fight and drop five enemies before it ends. A group of enemies bunched in one spot makes it far easier than five spread out across a street.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get to Vice City International Airport, get aboard an aircraft that was not scheduled to fly — steal a plane — and take off.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and put it to use. The trophy is tied to the tank itself, so find a Rhino — they turn up at military spots and high wanted levels — climb in and drive it into the action.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no one spotting you. Plan the entry, move slowly, take what you came for and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five separate bank vault robberies, each with a clean escape — treat each one like its own heist, get the vault open, take the cash and get clear before the law closes in.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and get away before the police pin you down — a fast car waiting nearby makes the escape far easier.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive through every named area of the map; the count ticks up as each new area loads. Sweep the state systematically and check the map for gaps — the last few areas are usually the ones at the edges.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs illegal operations around the state; hit one operation for every gang — nine in total — and keep a note of which gangs you have already hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take it in with the ocean in front of you.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's front and out the other side — pick a fast car and a straight line through the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the alley, play a game of bowling, and finish it — the trophy is about playing the game through, not the score.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. This one pops from a specific partnership moment as the story plays out — keep playing the main story and it will come to you on its own.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. PlayStation tracks a count toward 500 for this one — keep making choices as the game offers them, in missions and in the open world, and the counter climbs until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the second try — the trophy is about coming back and getting it right the second time around, so a failed attempt is not wasted.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange is out there in Leonida — stumble on one of the game's odd, out-of-place events and the trophy pops. Keep your eyes open while exploring, especially off the beaten track.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving past someone on foot, strike them with a melee attack from the vehicle — slow down just enough to line the swing up, then drive on.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; pass them to your contacts to launder, and the total adds up to $250,000 over time. Keep robbing and keep laundering.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, weapons and upgrades — every shop purchase counts toward the $100,000, so it fills naturally as you gear up through the game.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are for sale around Leonida; buy every one of the eight. Save up and work through the for-sale signs as you explore new areas.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone and register vehicles you find — ten registrations pop the trophy. Any ten vehicles count.
